mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '9' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_amount FROM contract_approve WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM contract_approve WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT contract_type, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM contract_approve WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY contract_type ORDER BY contract_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM contract_approve WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
